title: FB-016 guard TDarr materializer inventory paths
summary: Harden TDarr Matrix library materialization against unsafe inventory local_path values.
reason: Worker finding FR-053 identified that the Tdarr Matrix materializer accepted absolute and traversal inventory paths, then hardlinked arbitrary external media into generated test libraries.
behavior_before: Inventory local_path values were resolved with the generic repo-path resolver, so absolute paths were accepted and parent traversal could escape the inventory root before hardlink or copy materialization.
behavior_after: Inventory local_path values must be non-empty, inventory-relative, drive-free, and traversal-free. The resolved sample path must remain under the inventory root before the generated library root is prepared or any hardlink/copy occurs.
tests_added: tests/python/tooling/test_materialize_tdarr_test_library.py containment regressions for absolute and traversal inventory local_path values in hardlink/copy modes
manual_validation: Bundled Python: mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty files docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the TDarr materializer inventory path validation and related test/doc updates, then rerun the focused TDarr materializer and audit tooling tests.
